items.hed: Rockets, 7-1 after beating Boston, host Minnesota on Wednesday
items.insight: Houston tips off at Toyota Center at 8:30 p.m. ET after Monday's 109-93 win over the Celtics. Alperen Sengun led the Rockets with 26 points, 10 assists and seven rebounds, and Jabari Smith Jr. added 14 points and 10 rebounds.

items.hed: Texans sign defensive tackle Naquan Jones and release running back Deuce Vaughn
items.insight: Houston also waived defensive tackle Jaden Crumedy and added running back Joshua Pitsenberger of Yale to the practice squad, the club announced Monday. The Texans play next at the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 8, at SoFi Stadium, 3:05 p.m. CT on CBS.

items.hed: Astros activate Carlos Correa from the 60-day injured list and trade for right-hander Evan Reifert
items.insight: MLB's transaction log shows Houston also activated right-hander Mike Burrows and left-hander Brandon Walter from the 60-day list on Monday. The club got Reifert from Tampa Bay for cash, selected the contracts of right-hander Roddery Muñoz and catcher César Salazar from Triple-A Sugar Land, and sent center fielder Jake Meyers outright to Sugar Land.
